candidates.title: Woman killed, man injured as RTC electric bus hits bike taxi in Ameerpet
candidates.excerpt: A woman was killed and a man seriously injured after an RTC electric bus collided with a bike taxi at Ameerpet on Saturday. The woman, who was riding pillion, came under the bus wheels, while the injured rider was hospitalised.
